data.long_meaning: In Latin, Barcus means 'bearer of good news'. This name is derived from the Latin word 'bar', which means 'bearer'. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Barcus usually hope their child will grow to embody bearer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
